name: Rosanna Marasco
bioAdditions: Rosanna was buried at San Mango on 6 June 1820 as the widow of Angelo Moraca (S1), matching the tree's death date. No baptism was found; she may have been born outside San Mango.

relationships.evidence: Burial names her as widow of Angelus Moraca

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Tree data match an indexed San Mango parish entry (derivative index of a primary register; image online but not read by me).

sources.citation: San Mango d'Aquino (CZ), parish of San Tommaso d'Aquino, Morti 1811-1845 (Book 27), image 31, p. 53, no. 6; volunteer index 'Indici Morti - San Mango D'Aquino - Chiese di San Tommaso 1653-1713, 1747-1767, 1811-1942.xlsx' (ItalianParishRecords.org, San Mango d'Aquino page; indexers incl. D. Lupia and J. Bifano/Epifano), sheet '1811-1845'.
